definitions.label: Standing field
definitions.description: The standing-wave field used in Nacre. Modes N and M determine its nodal pattern.

definitions.label: Level response
definitions.description: Maps output RMS through sqrt(rms × sensitivity), clamps to 1, then follows it exponentially.

definitions.label: Field relief
definitions.description: Transforms each field sample: sin(sample × folds) × (rest depth + energy × audio depth).

definitions.label: Field comparison
definitions.description: Shows the source field beside the downstream relief. Both images consume actual graph inputs.
